Nvidia Corp. delivered earnings and revenue that surpassed Wall Street’s expectations and offered strong guidance for the current quarter in its first earnings call since the shocking resignation of its iconic co-founder and Chief Executive Jensen Huang. The results were so impressive that they slammed the brakes on a weeklong slide, as Nvidia’s stock rose […]

The post Business as usual for Nvidia as it beats expectations in first earnings call after Jensen Huang’s resignation appeared first on SiliconANGLE.
